thread:
maya: quick callout 1280px layout for the capacity control card is cramped. min/max steppers, burst toggle, pool chip, SLO slider, and cost badge are competing for space. thinking: introduce a compact view where burst details move to a popover and pool becomes a single-line summary; expand on click. also keyboard/tab order needs to be explicit.
jordan: compact-by-default makes sense for dashboards. concern: discoverability of burst. idea: first-run hint toast + per-user preference stored. i'll mock both compact and expanded.
liam: engineering: storing per-user preference is trivial. popover requires focus management (trap + esc). aria: use aria-haspopup, aria-controls, aria-expanded on the burst toggle. ensure SR announces slider changes via aria-live or aria-valuetext.
sophia: product: default expanded for trial orgs, compact for high-usage. propose heuristic: daily requests > 8k -> compact. copy: rename "Burst" to "Temporary burst" and helper under steppers: "Min/Max are targets; autoscaler may briefly exceed." keep under 50 chars for localization.
maya: accessibility nits: slider contrast needs to reach 4.5:1; show numeric tooltip while dragging and provide a visually-hidden live region announcing value on change. pool tooltip should show GPU type, region, median latency.
jordan: keyboard order suggestion: min -> max -> burst -> pool -> slo. ensure stepper buttons are 40px hit area min and have aria-labels like "increase min instances".
alex: implementation tips: keep DOM order matching visual order, use tabindex=0 for interactive elements. small CSS we reuse:
```
.card .stepper button { min-width:40px; min-height:40px; }
.slo-slider[aria-valuenow]::after { content: attr(aria-valuenow); position:absolute; }
```
Also ensure Enter/Space toggles burst and Esc closes popover returning focus.
liam: add a localization lint for microcopy length on badge/helper strings.
maya: action items: jordan to post two mocks with a11y annotations; alex to add keyboard behavior notes; liam to scope focus-trap work and estimate; sophia to confirm threshold and final microcopy. i'll open RED-4610 for the copy/a11y work.
design-bot: created ticket <https://redwood.app/t/RED-4610|RED-4610> "Capacity card: compact mode, a11y fixes, keyboard flow" :white_check_mark:
jordan: posting mocks shortly, will @maya when ready. :thumbsup:
